fix_plan.title: Frontend CORS Fix Plan - Content Security Policy Update
fix_plan.description: Fix CORS issues by updating Next.js Content Security Policy to allow ngrok domains
fix_plan.root_cause: Content Security Policy in next.config.js is blocking ngrok requests

files_to_modify.description: Update Content Security Policy to allow ngrok domains

changes.old_code: { key: 'Content-Security-Policy', value: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https:; frame-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';" }
changes.new_code: { key: 'Content-Security-Policy', value: "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https: *.ngrok.io *.ngrok-free.app; frame-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';" }
changes.reason: Add ngrok domains to connect-src directive to allow API requests

validation_steps.description: Clear browser cache completely (CSP headers are cached aggressively)
Restart Next.js development server with 'npm run dev'
Open browser DevTools Network tab and test cart API calls
Check that 'token' and 'authUser' cookies are being sent with requests
Complete full authentication cycle (login → dashboard → cart)
Verify no CORS errors appear in browser console

rollback_plan.description: If fix causes issues, revert the CSP change

production_considerations.reason: Alternative fix only adds ngrok domains in development mode

related_files.reason: Middleware doesn't interfere with API requests

expected_outcome.before_fix: Browser shows CORS errors, cart requests fail
expected_outcome.after_fix: Cart requests succeed, authentication works, no CORS errors
success_indicators: No CORS errors in browser console
Successful API requests in Network tab
